shop.question: for each category, the top 2 products by sales

naive.question: for each category, the top 2 products by sales
naive.sql:
WITH product_sales AS (
  SELECT
    p.category_id,
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.category_id
      ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC, p.id
    ) AS rn
  FROM products AS p
  INNER JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.id
  WHERE p.category_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    p.category_id,
    p.id,
    p.name
)
SELECT
  c.id AS category_id,
  c.name AS category_name,
  ps.product_id,
  ps.product_name,
  ps.total_units_sold
FROM product_sales AS ps
INNER JOIN categories AS c
  ON c.id = ps.category_id
WHERE ps.rn <= 2
ORDER BY
  c.id,
  ps.rn,
  ps.product_id

pq.question: for each category, the top 2 products by sales
pq.sql:
WITH product_sales AS (
  SELECT
    p.category_id,
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS sales_amount
  FROM products AS p
  LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.id
  GROUP BY
    p.category_id,
    p.id,
    p.name
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT
    c.id AS category_id,
    c.name AS category_name,
    ps.product_id,
    ps.product_name,
    ps.sales_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.id
      ORDER BY ps.sales_amount DESC, ps.product_id
    ) AS sales_rank
  FROM categories AS c
  JOIN product_sales AS ps
    ON ps.category_id = c.id
)
SELECT
  ranked_products.category_id,
  ranked_products.category_name,
  ranked_products.product_id,
  ranked_products.product_name,
  ranked_products.sales_amount,
  ranked_products.sales_rank
FROM ranked_products
WHERE ranked_products.sales_rank <= 2
ORDER BY
  ranked_products.category_id,
  ranked_products.sales_rank,
  ranked_products.product_id

shop.question: month-over-month order count for the last year

naive.question: month-over-month order count for the last year
naive.sql:
SELECT
  month_start,
  order_count,
  LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS previous_month_order_count,
  order_count - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS mom_change,
  ROUND(
    CASE
      WHEN LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) IS NULL
        OR LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) = 0
      THEN NULL
      ELSE (
        (order_count - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_start))::numeric
        / LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_start)
      ) * 100
    END,
    2
  ) AS mom_percent_change
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', orders.created_at) AS month_start,
    COUNT(orders.id) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  WHERE orders.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '11 months'
    AND orders.created_at < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', orders.created_at)
) AS monthly_orders
ORDER BY month_start

pq.question: month-over-month order count for the last year
pq.sql:
SELECT
  to_char(month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  order_count,
  LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS previous_month_order_count,
  order_count - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS mom_change,
  ROUND(
    (
      (order_count - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_start))::numeric
      / NULLIF(LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_start), 0)
    ) * 100,
    2
  ) AS mom_change_pct
FROM (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', orders.created_at) AS month_start,
    COUNT(orders.id) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  WHERE orders.created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '11 months'
    AND orders.created_at < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', orders.created_at)
) AS monthly_orders
ORDER BY month_start

pq.sql:
WITH product_sales AS (
  SELECT
    p.category_id,
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,

  GROUP BY
    p.category_id,
    p.id,
    p.name
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT
    ps.category_id,
    ps.product_id,
    ps.product_name,
    ps.total_sales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY ps.category_id
      ORDER BY ps.total_sales DESC, ps.product_id
    ) AS sales_rank
  FROM product_sales AS ps
)
SELECT
  c.id AS category_id,
  c.name AS category_name,
  rp.product_id,
  rp.product_name,
  rp.total_sales,
  rp.sales_rank
FROM ranked_products AS rp
INNER JOIN categories AS c
  ON c.id = rp.category_id
WHERE rp.sales_rank <= 2
ORDER BY
  c.id,
  rp.sales_rank,
  rp.product_id

naive.question: month-over-month order count for the last year
naive.sql:
SELECT
  to_char(months.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  COALESCE(order_counts.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
  COALESCE(order_counts.order_count, 0)
    - COALESCE(LAG(order_counts.order_count) OVER (ORDER BY months.month_start), 0) AS mom_change,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(LAG(order_counts.order_count) OVER (ORDER BY months.month_start), 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(
      (
        (COALESCE(order_counts.order_count, 0) - LAG(order_counts.order_count) OVER (ORDER BY months.month_start))::numeric
        / LAG(order_counts.order_count) OVER (ORDER BY months.month_start)
      ) * 100,
      2
    )
  END AS mom_change_pct
FROM (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '11 months',
    date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE),
    INTERVAL '1 month'
  ) AS month_start
) AS months
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', orders.created_at) AS month_start,
    COUNT(orders.id) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  WHERE orders.created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '11 months'
    AND orders.created_at < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', orders.created_at)
) AS order_counts
  ON months.month_start = order_counts.month_start
ORDER BY months.month_start

pq.question: month-over-month order count for the last year
pq.sql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('month', orders.created_at) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('month', orders.created_at)) AS mom_change,
  ROUND(
    (
      (COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('month', orders.created_at)))::numeric
      / NULLIF(LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('month', orders.created_at)), 0)
    ) * 100,
    2
  ) AS mom_change_pct
FROM orders
WHERE orders.created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '11 months'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', orders.created_at)
ORDER BY month
